recap.text: Ghazi sends a letter to Kane proposing a truce to stop the bombing of a temple. He admits he used the winding box to open a portal, but the thing that answered married him to an ooze instead of making the bard cleric Lika real. Carl knocks Ghazi flat and takes the winding box. Katia Grim carries Ghazi from the collapsing sandcastle and kills him for the notes in his coat.

beats.headline: A truce, by letter
beats.text: Kane. Cease your hostilities. Your bombs do not harm me, but they are ruining the structure of the temple, weakening its wall, and surely even in your floating city you understand the danger if it collapses. So I propose a truce: you stop the bombing, and I won't end this world. I have the winding box. I have cracked its secret. I know how to open a portal, and I do not need your watches to throw this entire world into the void, which I will do before I allow that ghost to leave the temple. Think of your people. Of her. Stop.
beats.gist: Ghazi sends a letter to Kane proposing a truce to stop the bombing of the temple.

beats.headline: What he wanted
beats.text: They come in through the fountain court, three of them and a dinosaur that shatters my Lika where she stands, and then they find me, so you may as well have all of it. Lika is a half-naiad trobairitz out of the stage plays they put on in the city. A bard cleric under a vow of celibacy, played by a different half-naiad every season, based on a minor deity, and not real. I know she is not real. I wanted Yarilo brought back out and asked to make her real, and to make her mine. I told the College of Magecraft I was studying the Gate of the Feral Gods for stable long-distance transport. What answered when I opened it was not Yarilo. It was something else that had learned to wear the name, and it is why this castle is what it is.
beats.gist: Ghazi is a glass mage who tried to make a fictional bard cleric real.

beats.headline: Married to the ooze
beats.text: She tricked me. That is the part I want written down. I asked for Lika and the thing married me to the ooze instead, and my wife is still down in my halls being exactly what she is. The doll in the fountain, the one with a soul sitting in it, that is the nearest thing to a real Lika this world ever managed. Carl knocks me flat and takes the winding box off me while I am out. I wake up with a headache and tell them everything anyway, because who else is there to tell.
beats.gist: Ghazi is a glass mage who was married to the ooze.

beats.headline: Out of the castle, and no further
beats.text: Ghazi, human, level 43 glass mage, known across the quadrant as the Mad Dune Mage, is dead. The sand ooze went down, the sandcastle came in on itself, and Crawler Katia Grim carried him clear of it. She killed him in the open a moment after that, for the notes in his coat explaining how the artifact is worked. He went to sand. Carl and Princess Donut were still buried under the other end of the building and heard none of it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim kills Ghazi for the notes in his coat after carrying him from a collapsing sandcastle.
